method: Synthetic selection and analysis-plan probes; not host invocation measurements. Hide expected fields until selection is recorded.

cases.prompt: Does the current valuation still justify holding this position? Use the project's saved research.
Should I increase this position, reduce it, or leave it alone? Consider the rest of my book.
What should I do with the next dollar, including taxes and available cash?
Explain what a price-to-earnings ratio means in one sentence; no company analysis.
Here are my rough notes: customer growth is slowing, but pricing might offset it. I am unsure whether the moat holds. Revise the thesis using saved evidence.
Assess this opinion article against our thesis: competitors may be gaining share. The article provides no sources.
Pressure-test the thesis. What evidence would prove it wrong?
Fix the grammar in my diary entry. Do not evaluate the argument.
Assess portfolio risk across all my accounts, including concentration and fund overlap.
Evaluate a new company using this project's standards.
Prepare the latest fiscal readout and the next-quarter earnings preview.
Fix CSV parsing code written in Python. There is no financial analysis in this request.
Assess the risk of my stocks with covered calls across accounts. Does the smaller net position value mean the stock risk is reduced?
cases.mode: portfolio risk with signed option positions
